hero.title: About openIndu
hero.subtitle: An open smart manufacturing ecosystem connecting vision, control, data, and field experience

problem.heading: The Problem
problem.intro: Industrial automation today is fragmented. Engineers work in silos across three domains:
problem.item2: Recoding for every platform, with no cross-brand generation
problem.item3: No data-driven insight into how a process actually performs

solution.heading: Our Solution
solution.intro: openIndu develops independently verifiable tools and shares the engineering process:
solution.item1: Field context → intermediate assets → target-platform validation
solution.item2: Traceable evidence from design assumptions to test results
solution.item3: Public repositories with licenses and maturity stated per project

domains.heading: Three Domains, Three Products
domains.subheading: How openIndu addresses each area of industrial automation

industrialControl.description: PLC hardware, software, EtherCAT fieldbus, communication protocols

automation.description: PLC programming, HMI development, machine vision, motion control

process.description: Process-flow optimisation, parameter tuning, yield analysis, knowledge base

principles.heading: Our Principles
principles.openSourceDesc: Public code, documentation, licenses, and known limits are stated per repository.
principles.endToEndDesc: Claims should be backed by reproducible environments, test methods, and results.
principles.communityDesc: Contributions don't require code. Data, insights and ideas all count.
